start.speaker: yev
start.text: I dreamed the grove was whole again and you were in it. Not weaponised. Not sacred. Just green. Is that what after looks like?

choices.text: Yev, there is no after for us. I am ending it now.

ended.speaker: yev
ended.text: The current turns. It always turns. I will not pretend it does not hurt; I am serene, not stone. Go well.
